name: LinOTP
description: Multi-factor authentication server that issues and validates one-time passwords across many token types.

envVars.description: Password for the LinOTP database user
Password for the LinOTP admin user

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      LINOTP_DATABASE_URI: "mysql://linotp:{{env.MYSQL_PASSWORD}}@{{serviceName}}-mariadb/linotp"
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: {{env.MYSQL_PASSWORD}}
      LINOTP_ADMIN_PASSWORD: {{env.LINOTP_ADMIN_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/var/lib/linotp
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-mariadb
  {{serviceName}}-mariadb:
    image: mariadb:11
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-mariadb
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      MYSQL_DATABASE: linotp
      MYSQL_USER: linotp
      MYSQL_PASSWORD: {{env.MYSQL_PASSWORD}}
      MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD: {{env.MYSQL_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/mariadb:/var/lib/mysql
